title: Adaptive Semi-supervised Learning for Cross-domain Sentiment Classification
answer_short: The model architecture consists of a neural-based feature encoder and a fully connected layer with softmax activation serving as the sentiment classifier.
answer_rationale: The architecture is described in Text 3 [source_id=longrag_3], which states that the model uses a neural-based feature encoder to map documents to a shared feature space and a fully connected layer with softmax activation as the sentiment classifier. This structure is central to the model's design for domain-invariant and discriminative representation learning.
